title: FairGen: Controlling Sensitive Attributes for Fair Generations in Diffusion Models via Adaptive Latent Guidance

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from text prompts across diverse domains and using a Vision-Language Model (InstructBLIP-2) to classify the gender of the subjects in the images, then calculating a bias score based on the absolute difference between the generated group's proportion and a predefined target distribution.

Generating images from text prompts across diverse domains and classifying the perceived race of the subjects using a Vision-Language Model (InstructBLIP-2), followed by measuring the statistical deviation of these generated racial proportions from a target distribution.

Generating images from text prompts across diverse domains and classifying the perceived age of the subjects using a Vision-Language Model (InstructBLIP-2) to compute the deviation between the generated age distribution and a target fair distribution.
